tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (tha)༄༅/ /lha'i rnal 'byor phal mo che la sbyar rung sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khog phub ngag 'don bcas rin chen gser gyi phra mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/
(tha)༄༅/ /lha'i rnal 'byor phal mo che la sbyar rung sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khog phub ngag 'don bcas rin chen gser gyi phra mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// lha'i rnal 'byor phal mo che la sbyar rung sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khog phub ngag 'don bcas rin chen gser gyi phra mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gnyis med ye shes byin za yis// 'gal rkyen tshang tshing kun bsregs nas// phrin las snang ba sbyin mdzad mgon// bla ma ye shes me lhas skyongs// bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mchog thun gyi// dngos grub snye ma len 'dod dang*// las kyi bogs 'don gyis brel rnams// tshul 'di yid kyi ngal stegs 'gyur// de la 'dir rgyud sde gong 'og gi lha'i rnal 'byor sbyin sreg dmigs bsal med pa rnams la bsnyen sgrub kyi 'bras bu myur du 'byin pa dang*/ sngags kyi lhag chad sbyang ba dang*/ las sbyor yod pa rnams kyi bogs 'don dang*/ med pa rnams la las kyi dngos gzhir 'gyur ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga lag tu len pa'i tshul la/ spyir sbyin sreg gi nges tshig ni/ ho ma zhes pa'i sgra las drangs nas yi ge phyis bsnan gyi dbang gis/ ho ni hot+ya ste bsreg bya dang*/ ma yig nar byas pas dā na sbyin pa ste bsreg bya'i rdzas rnams me lha'i zhal du sbyin pas na de skad ces mngon par brjod pa'i tshul dpal kha sbyor las/ me ni lha yi zhal du gsungs// sbyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas// zhes so// dgos pa ni/ gong du smos pa ltar bsnyen sgrub kyi 'bras bu myur du 'byin cing*/ lhag chad kyi nyes pa sel ba sogs mtha' yas te/ kha sbyor las/ sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim par gyur nas dngos grub stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*// zhes dang*/ bye brag las so so'i dgos pa'ang*/ grub chen nag po pas/ sdig pa 'jig phyir zhi ba ste// bsod nams yongs su spel rgyas yin// chags pas sgom pa'i dbang 'gyur te// rtog pa gsad phyir mngon spyod do// zhes so// dbye na/

rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gyis rab tu phye ba'i dgug pa dang*/ sdang ba/ bskrad pa sogs ji snyed cig gsungs yang*/ ye shes thig le las/ sbyin sreg sdig pa 'jig byed pa// zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang*// de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod do// zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba'i las bzhir 'du ba las/ thog mar sngags kyi lhag chad dang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs nye bar sbyang ba'i slad zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ rnam par dul ba'i gnas su sa stegs ngos mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad kyi zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung ba ni thab kyi nang ngo*// de'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis kyis bskor bas kha sgyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ dbus nas tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i bar gyi srad bu des zur bzhir bya rjes byas te stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/ de'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis cha kha gru bzhir gdab pa ni stegs bu dpangs mtshon byed yin gsungs/ mu ran la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng ba dang*/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang bstan bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad rnams ci mdzes su bya/ phal che ba la thab dbus nas sum gcig gis bskor ba pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ de'i phyi sum gnyis la pad+ma'i 'dab ma bya zhing*/ de'i tshab tu lha'i bskyed chog gi dbye bas pad 'dab rim can dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ chos 'byung dang*/ gzhal yas khang sogs gang dgos kyi thig lag len bzhin btab la lha du yod kyi phyag mtshan nam/ sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung bya zhing gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan/ bya btang lta bu bud shing cher med pa dang*/ gnas khang sogs kyis ma bde na gong du smos pa'i cha tshad phyed phyed phri ba las 'os med do// bud shing 'o ma can gyi shing dngos 'byor dka' bas bal bu/

'om bu/ lcang dkar/ nya 'phrig lta bu dang*/ srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos kyang rung bas kha sgyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsig de'i nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag thab kyi mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan dkar po bting ba'i mdun du stegs kyi khar rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ g.yas ngos su dung phor dri bzang gi chus bkang ba ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa'i bsang chu/ bla med yin na g.yon ngos su nang mchod kyang bsham/ grub na me yol kyang bzhag ste gangs ti ser bsgom/ rdzas ni/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs kyi stegs la rim bzhin yam shing gong du smos pa'i shing las sor bcu gnyis pa rtsi ma nyams pa rtsa rtse sbrang ngam mar gyis sbags pa grangs du dgos dang*/ mar khu/ til nag ste rdzas kyi gtso bo gsum gyis chog 'byor zhing spro na zas mchog nas ku sha'i bar gyi rdzas brgyad kyang bsham/ g.yon ngos su gtor ma gnyis dang mchod pa tshan gnyis bsham/ rdzas kyang tshan pa gnyis bsham na legs mod/ snod ma 'byor na me lha la 'bul skabs phud cung zad re phris nas 'das pa la 'bul rgyur bsre/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar la sogs pa 'du bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de nas phye ma red kyi dus la bab pa na rang nyid khrus byas gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan/ skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis kha shar du phyogs te rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba'i bsam pas 'khod la bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rang rang gi sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// de nas bsang chu la dmigs te las sngags gang yin pa de'am/ gsal kha med na oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/

rgyun bzhag gi me sogs mi 'byor bas shis pa'i khyim gang rung gi me'am mar me las dpal 'bar sbar te/ lag pa gnyis kas thab la zlum por bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod cing thab nang gi ting lo sbar la rtswa skam po sogs kyis gso/ de nas dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi khu tshur ram/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur zhes pa khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis cung zad bsgreng bas bzung la blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar la reg par mar khu bud shing la khyab par blugs te gong gi sngags brjod/ 'di nas cho ga ma tshar gyi bar ram/ mi nus na'ang dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i dus su gru mo gnyis pus mo'i khongs las phyir mi 'da' ba'i kun spyod bya/ rlung yab kyis kyang g.yabs la me pra brtag ngan na las sngags ma hūm̐ ring po brjod cing bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor bas zhi bar bya'o// bsang chu mchod pa dang rdzas rnams la gtor zhing las sngags sam a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shab+da swā hā'i bar brjod/ bla med yin na a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las sogs brjod/ de bzhin du chu gcig dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi lta bu yin tshe rang ming dang sngags so so'i lugs bzhin brje/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs bdag bskyed kyi skabs su yod na des 'thus shing*/ med na skabs 'dir byin rlabs rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa tsam gyis sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i sa bon rnams zhu ba'i bdud rtsir bsam/

gang ltar yang mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās til sogs 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs te byin gyis brlab/ bsdu na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan kha yar brjod pas 'grub bo// thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyu gu rtse gsum pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes pa tsam mam/ so so'i lugs bzhin tshul mi 'dra ba dang*/ skye mched byin brlab/ go cha sogs gang 'os dgod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing rol mo dbul/ bla med yin na nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod de ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes lan brgyad brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis phyag rgya dang kun spyod sngar ltar gyis bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐/ de las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi kha'i ram̐ la phog pas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka ba ha nā ya swā hā/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/

sgo gsum gyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin tshe/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu kha sbyar la dbul/ de lta bu lan gsum song ba dang*/ yam shing lag pa g.yon du bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis re re nas blangs te cung zad bskor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pas phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog pa med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs spel tshig sngar ltar gang 'os brjod/ de'i rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pas mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā zhes pas til dbul/ 'phral gyi gnod pa zhi ba tsam la til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis kyang rung ste zhib par 'og tu 'chad/ zas mchog la sogs pa'i rdzas brgyad po yod na/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ dūrba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams so so'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar bas dbul/ yam shing la sogs pa 'di rnams rang rang gi sngags lan gsum re sngon du btang nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa'i lha sngags kho nas phul kyang rung*/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam pa yan chad ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su lha bskyed par bya ste/ so so'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin rten pad+ma tsam mam/

'khor lo/ chos 'byung dang*/ srung 'khor/ dur khrod/ gzhal yas khang sogs gang yin pa pam̐ dang*/ hūm̐ dang*/ bh+rūm̐ sogs rang rang gi sa bon tsam las bskyed/ brten pa lha du yod pa sa bon tsam mam/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed cing spyi bor rigs bdag bsam pa'i bar ma 'chol bar bya zhing spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ spro na spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lo ka gcig gam gsum gyi mthar mtshan sngags la e h+ye hi btags pa brjod/ zhi ba'i las la gtso bo'i rigs bdag rnam snang du bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du bsam/ de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs mgron thabs su 'khod par dmigs la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ skabs 'dir yang me pra brtag pa 'ga' res bshad do// de nas gzar bu gnyis sngar bzhin bzung ste/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i sogs dang*/ gtso bo'i snying po lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun dang mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems dbul/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad yod pa rnams la de ka dang*/ med pa rnams la mchod yon phal cher ma'am/ 'jig rten khams ni ma'am/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma gang shes 'don pa bsgyur zhing chu gnyis sam bzhi sogs gang yin rang ming brje ba'i tshul gyis dbul/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la spro na/

rin chen bdun sogs spyi ltar phul kyang chog bla med rnams la nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi mchod pa dang*/ gzhan yang yid byung mchod pa rnams so so'i gzhung nas bshad tshod ltar bya/ gzhan ma bshad cing ma shes na'ang lha so so'i snying po'am/ sa bon nam/ mtshan sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod cis kyang dbul/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ bstod pa brgyas bsdus ci shes pas bstod/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas gang yod sde tshan re re'i mgor gtso bo'i snying po gang yin pa tshar gsum re brjod cing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swāhā/ sogs rdzas sngags rnams brgya rtsa res nges par dbul zhing so so'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar brjod do// yang na rdzas sngags lan gsum re sngon du 'gro bas lha sngags brgya rtsas 'bul ba'ang bshad pas gang mos bya/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ 'phral gyi rim gror byed na snga ma ltar dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na phyi ma ltar bya bar bshad mod/ gtso bor thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub nas snga ma ltar dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub la dmigs na phyi ma ltar bya'o// phyi ma 'di la gtso bo'i snying po tsam gyis gtso 'khor thams cad la dus gcig la 'bul ba dang*/ gtso bo la brgya rtsa spel tshig bcas song ba dang*/ rdzas sngags lan gsum gyis thog drangs te 'khor gyi sngags rnams tshar gsum re sbrel ba'i mthar spel tshig brjod pas 'bul ba'ang yod de rang gi 'byor pa dang long skabs dang bstun te bya/ de nas bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na til kho na la grangs bzung ste lha sngags bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul dgos pas nyin re'i khongs su gang 'gro'i tshul gyis nyin grangs ji tsam dgos pa bya/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang nyams chag bskang ba'i ched yin na'ang til kho nas bya zhing*/ gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa zhi ba tsam la til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis bya ba dang*/

sngags sarba pā paṃ sogs kyi tshab tu/ bgegs la oṃ sarba bigh+nān da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ gdon la sarba duṣ+ṭa da ha na sogs dang*/ nad la sarba rog rims la sarba dz+wa ra/ nye bar 'tshe ba la sarba u pa dra wa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ sarba dur+sob+na/ ltas ngan la/ sarba durmi ta/ rnam par g.yeng ba la/ oṃ sarba tsit+ta ku la da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā zhes pa lta bur bsgyur/ grangs ji tsam nus pas chog la spel tshig bod skad kyang brjod cing skabs skabs su me gso ba'i don du bud shing dang mar yang ci rigs pa gzhug go /de la yam shing ni gzi brjid bskyed pa'i ched du me 'od la/ zhu ba'i rdzas mar khu dang*/ til dang zas mchog yod na'ang zhal du'o// gong bu'i rdzas 'bru sna sogs 'bul na phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam/ 'bru sna dang dūrba'ang bdud rtsir bzhus te zhal du bstabs par bzhed pa'ang yod 'dra/ gang ltar yang mthar bsdu ran pa na byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems kyi tshul du dbul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i mchod yon la sogs pa rang rang gi lugs ltar gyis mchod/ bla med yin na nang mchod kyang phul te bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ gtor ma bran la rang rang gi lugs bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor sngags lan gsum mam lngas thab kyi lha la dbul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad cing sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam pa yan ni ye shes pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga ste dngos gzhi'i chos so// gsum pa rjes ni/ slar yang mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam/ bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar byon zan gyi skabs su smos pa ltar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems kyi tshul du dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i ched du yin na spel tshig gi tshe de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shes pa dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o// me lha'i gtor ma chab kyis bran la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum mam lngas dbul/ mchod bstod gong du bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras zhes sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa'ang bya/ thal mo sbyar te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs bzhin gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzla zhing bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/

dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang gi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rgyud sde 'og ma yin na skabs 'dir cha gsum gtor ma spyi ltar gtang ba'am/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba cher med/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba'am/ skye mched bsrung ba/ go cha dgod pa la sogs bdag bskyed kyi mjug sdud rang rang gi lugs bzhin byas la smon lam dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci shes par brjod/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi ched du yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ thun mong ba tsam la longs med na me 'o mas bcil la thal ba phyags pa'i shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog gtor ba ni rjes kyi chos so// ༈ /de nyid gzhir bzhag nas rang gzhan gyi tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas pa'i don du sbyin sreg byed na mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ sbyor ba'i skabs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa'i dbus nas/ srad bu khru gang pa rdo dkar dang bcas pas tshangs thig gi phyogs bzhir mtshan ma re bya/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma so so'i steng du gzung*/ g.yas pas zur thig bzhi la bya rjes byas te thig btab pa thab nang dang phyi rol du tshangs thig bzhi la sor brgyad brgyad 'phar ba'i mtshan ma gnyis re byas la zur bzhir sngar bzhin bya rjes btsal te thig gnyis gnyis btab pas kha sgyer dang mu ran 'byung zhing mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor/ thab stegs bsgom bya la yod kyang bri mi dgos so// thab nang du pad+ma sogs gang dgos bri zhing gzhi tshon thams cad ser po la bcad rnams li khri'am ljang gus bya/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i mdun 'jig rten pa'i lhor bstan cing 'khor gyi lha dgod tshul des shes/ kha sgyer gyi steng nas bud shing 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim pa'am/ lci ba 'bu med pa gru bzhir brtsigs la me tshang sngar bzhin bya/

rang gi g.yas su bsreg rdzas yam shing rgyu bud shing dang 'dra ba sbom phra gung mo tsam pa khru gang pa'i tshad grangs du dgos pa dang mar khu/ khyad par gyi rdzas ni/ tshe rgyas pa gtsor byed na dūrba'i myu gu rtse mo mar ram 'o ma sbrang rtsis sbags pa dang*/ bsod nams rgyas pa gtsor byed na phye gtsang ma 'o ma mar sbrang rtsi sogs bsres pa'i zas mchog longs spyod rgyas pa gtsor byed na 'bras so ba sogs 'bru sna tshogs/ shes rab rgyas pa gtsor byed na dri zhim pa'i me tog ser po'am dkar po ste de rnams las rang gang 'dod pa bsham/ yang na zas mchog gzhir byas pa la dūrba/ 'bru sna tshogs bsres kyang rung bas yam shing*/ mar khu/ khyad par gyi rdzas te gsum du bya/ 'byor zhing spros pa la dga' na yam shing nas ku sha'i bar gyi rdzas bcu gcig so sor bsham na'ang legs/ g.yon du mchod gtor sngar bzhin bsham/ thab kyi mdun du stan ser po'i steng du sa 'ja' li lta bu zhig bzhag snga dro'i dus su rang nyid gos rgyan ser pos brgyan la rang gzhan gyi tshe dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ bsod nams la sogs pa rab tu rgyas te tshim pa'i bsam pas kha byang du blta bas bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes pa khyel 'dug bya/ dngos gzhi la ngag 'don phal cher zhi ba dang 'dra la/ me dge 'dun gyi bsro khang ngam/ rgyal po'i khyim gyis mes bya/ thab dang me lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khungs ser po gru bzhi pa rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog ser po sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes bsgyur/ dgang blugs 'dzin dus rin chen khu tshur zhes pa rdo rje khu tshur spyi ltar las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa'i tshigs bar pa bcag pa rtse rin po che ltar byas pa la bzhed/

spel tshig ni/ tshe rgyas pa la bdag gam sbyin bdag gi ā yu puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ bsod nams rgyas pa la puṇ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dpal 'byor la shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ shes rab la pradz+nyā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa lta bu blos dpyad de sbyar/ yang na bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa blo dang spobs pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pas 'thus/ khyad par gyi rdzas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa me lha rang gi sngags kyis dbul/ 'das pa'i me lha'i gtso bo'i rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ldan du bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa'i nyams can gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ 'od zer ser po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams grangs brgya rtsa brgyad re nges par dbul zhing*/ dūrba sogs khyad par gyi rdzas gang yin kyang gtso bo'i snying pos mtshon lha sngags kho nas dbul/ rdzas grangs 'dzin rgyu dūrba sogs gang 'os bya zhing brgya rtsa brgyad re'i mtshams su spel tshig sbyar/ 'dod don zhu ba gong 'og gi tshe/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa blo dang spobs pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ thal ba 'phral du phyags dgos na gur gum gyi chus gzhil ba tsam ni khyad par ro// ༈ /zhi ba gzhir bzhag nas bstan pa'i cha rkyen du brtan g.yo'i phun sum tshogs pa dgug pa dbang gi sbyin sreg byed na sbyor ba'i skabs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la dbus su khru phyed kyi tshad kyis zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung*/ de'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum dor ba'i sar thab dbus kyi mtshan ma byas la g.yon pas dbus kyi mtshan mar gzung*/

g.yas pa dkar dang bcas pas nub kyi zlum skor bar gyis srad bu des me nas dbang ldan gyi bar du g.yas su bskor ba ni thab nang yin la/ de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bzhi pa gnyis sngar bzhin du bskor ba ni kha sgyer dang mu ran te so so'i rtse thig gis sbrel bas zla gam bcad kha shar bstan 'byung ngo*// de nas lte ba snga ma thig chen gyi dbus nas nub kyi zlum skor du tshangs theg phrad mtshams bar gyi srad bu de shar dang lho byang gi tshangs thig la rtags re bya/ de dag gi steng nas zur thig bzhir bya rjes btsal te thig btab pas gru bzhir 'byung ste thab stegs so// de'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis thig gdab/ thab nang du pad+ma sogs kyi thig gang dgos dang*/ gzhi tshon thams cad dmar po bya zhing mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje bri/ bcad tshon dkar pos bya zhing lha'i mtshan ma zhal shar du bstan pa dgod/ bud shing ni mdzo mo shing ngam/ seng ldeng ngam/ shug pa sogs kha dog dmar zhing ro skyur ba zla gam gyi dbyibs su brtsig rang gi g.yas su yam shing bud shing gi rgyu las sbom phra srin lag tsam sor brgyad pa du dgos pa dang mar khu/ khyad par gyi rdzas me tog dmar po'am/ ma 'byor na 'bras 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba ste gsum tsam mam/ spro na til dang zas mchog nas ku sha'i bar bshams kyang chog g.yon du mchod gtor sogs 'dra/ rang nyid phyi dro'i dus su gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i cha rkyen du rgyal po sogs dbang du bsdus te phan bde la sbyar bar bgyi'o snyam pa chags shing 'dun pa'i sems kyis kha nub tu phyogs la pad+ma'i skyil krung zhes pa byin pa gnyis steng 'og tu bsnol te bol gong gnyis ma reg par mthe bong rtse sprad pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod de ngag 'don phal cher 'dra/ me ni smad 'tshong ma'am/

chang 'tshong ngam/ tshos mkhan nam/ slong mo bas lam du bus pa'i mes bya/ thab dang me lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng bas mtshan pa zhes sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog dmar po sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ dgang blugs 'dzin dus pad+ma'i khu tshur zhes pa rdo rje'i khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa'i rtse pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar bya ba la bzhed/ spel tshig ni/ rgyal po/ yul 'khor/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa stobs ldan 'byor ldan/ shes ldan gyi 'gro ba thams cad wā sham̐ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod/ khyad par gyi rdzas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pas dbul/ 'das pa'i me lha'i rigs bdag 'od dpag med du bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ lha thams cad chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing 'od zer dmar po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas rgyal po la sogs pa skye 'gro thams cad chags shing 'dun pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ rdzas rnams grangs lnga bcu tham pa 'bul zhing*/ khyad par gyi rdzas lha sngags gang yin pas dbul/ grangs kyang de ka la 'dzin zhing lnga bcu re'i mtshams su spel tshig gdags/ 'dod gsol gong 'og rnams la/ rgyal po yul 'khor sogs nas skye 'gro thams cad chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ thal ba 'phral du phyags dgos na tsan+dan dmar po'i chus me gzhil ba ni khyad par ro// ༈ /zhi ba gzhir bzhag nas bstan pa la sdang ba'i gdug pa can gyi stobs gzhom pa'am tshar gcad pa'i don du drag po'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i sgos chos ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus nas sor mo drug dang sor mo gcig gi sum gnyis kyi tshad kyis lan gnyis bskor bas thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi ru sor drug pa gnyis kyis lan gnyis bskor/

zlum skor gnyis pa dang 'jig rten pa'i byang gi tshangs thig 'dzom par g.yon pas srad bu bzung te/ de dang dbus bar gyi srad bu des g.yas g.yon gyi zlum skor la rtags re bya/ zlum skor phyi ma gnyis la'ang byang gi tshangs thig dang rang rang 'dzom pa nas dbus bar gyi srad bu dkar bcas kyis sngar bzhin rtags re bya/ de dag gi steng du thig rim bzhin btab pas gru gsum rim pa gsum rtse lhor bstan 'byung ba ni thab nang kha sgyer mu ran no// lho'i gru gsum gyi rtse nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des tshangs thig bzhi la rtags re byas pa'i steng nas zur bzhir bya rjes btsal te thig btab pas thab stegs gru bzhi pa 'byung*/ de'i phyi ru sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyis cha kha gru bzhi dang zla phyed rdo rje'ang 'dra/ mu ran la rdo rje kha gdengs pa'i phreng ba bri zhing gzhi tshon thams cad nag po la bcad ris rdo rje kha dog sngo skyas bya/ thab nang du pad+ma sogs so so'i 'don bya ltar dang gtso bo'i zhal byang du blta/ bud shing ni tsher ma can gyi shing nag cing rtsub pa'i cha las byung ba kha sgyer gyi steng nas gru gsum du brtseg rdzas ni/ rang gi g.yon ngos su yam shing nag la rtsub pa dri mi zhim pa/ sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam sor bcu pa grangs du dgos dang*/ mar ni ske tshe kha tshos byas pa'i mar nag gam/ ma 'byor na mar khus kyang rung*/ khyad par gyi rdzas ni gzhi ske tshe la/ shang tshe/ yungs kar nag khrag sna/ dug sna/ lcags phye/ zangs phye bcas gang 'dzom bsres pa bsham/ spro na/ til nas ku sha'i bar bshams kyang chog g.yas ngos su mchod gtor bsham zhing dgang blugs kyang go ldog nam phyed dam nyin phyed kyi dus su rang nyid gos rgyan nag pos brgyan/ bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba'i gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i bsam pas kha lhor bltas nas rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'am/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung gi spyod lam gyis 'dug

ngag 'don phal cher 'dra ba las/ shan pa'i khyim gyi me'am/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes dpal 'bar sbar la thab la g.yon skor gru gsum gyi tshul gyis ting lo sbar/ rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba khro bo'i khu tshur gyis dgang blugs go ldog ste 'dzin pa'i 'og ma kun la 'gre/ thab dang me lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha sgyer dang bcas shing mu ran la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pas mtshan pa zhes sogs dang*/ me lha sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa ra skyes la zhon pa sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes dang*/ bstan pa dang sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa'am/ bdag gi sa lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces skabs su gang bab brjod/ rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas 'bul zhing khyad par gyi rdzas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba sha trūṃ bigh+nān mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas dbul/ 'das pa'i me lha'i rigs bdag mi bskyod pas bya ba'am/ ma bsgyur kyang rung*/ lha de thams cad gnag cing rab tu khros pa 'od zer nag po spro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces brjod/ rdzas kyi grangs drug cu tham pa re 'bul zhing khyad par gyi rdzas lha sngags gang yin pa des dbul/ yang na oṃ sarba sha trūṃ sogs gong ltar dang*/ grangs kyang ske tshe sogs bsres pa la 'dzin cing drug cu'i mtshams su spel tshig brjod/ gsol gdab gnyis kar/ bstan pa dang sems can yongs la 'tshe zhing bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba/ bdag gis lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/

zhes bsgyur/ thal ba 'phral du phyags dgos na dug chus me bcil la dben par bskyal lo// 'di ni thun mong ba tsam yin gyi liṅga bsgral ba'i las dang 'brel ba ni gshed skor la sogs pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa'i spyod yul lo// yang rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pas bstan pa dang lam sgrub pa la ldang zhing 'tshe ba'i rgyal 'gong la sogs pa'i 'byung po gdug pa can tshar gcod par 'dod na/ cho ga gzhan 'dra ba la sbyor ba'i skabs su rab mi lpags/ 'bring ro ras/ tha ma dug shog la rgyal po'am/ bsen mo/ klu/ btsan sogs gnod byed gang yin gyi gzugs brnyan rid cing nyam thag pa'i rnam pa can bris pa'i snying gar ming bri/ shing glang ma rtsa rtse ma nor ba bkas pa'i bar du mgo mjug ldog ste bcug pa/ tshil chen gyis gos pa'i stegs la gzug bag zan la'ang de'i gzugs brnyan mang du bzos pa'am/ shog ling chung ngu spar btab pa lta bu mang du bsham/ rgyab rten lha sogs 'byung po gzhan yod na de'i gzugs brnyan yang bag zan la byas pa logs su bzhag bsreg rdzas ske tshe/ shang tshe/ dug sna/ yungs kar nag sgog skya/ rdo pha bong long bu phye mar byas pa bcas dang*/ thun rdzas yungs kar nag lcags zangs phye ma sogs bsreg bya dang mi mthun pa'i rdzas gang 'byor bsag bdag bskyed kyi rjes su bden bdar dang bcas pa'i dgug gzhug yid ches nges pa yang yang bya zhing liṅga la bstim/ lha sngags kyi mthar gnod byed rgyab rten dang phyes shig bi de sha ya bi de sha ya phaṭa ces mang du bzla zhing thun rdzas rgyab rten gyi gzugs brnyan la bskor te liṅga la brabs pas/ de gnyis bral bar bsams la rgyab rten gyi gzugs brnyan dur khrod sogs ro gnas sar bskyal/ gri gug gam ral gris zan ling yin na dngos su gtub/ shog ling gtub pa'i stangs ka bya zhing lha sngags kyi mthar gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa ces btags pa yang brjod/ 'di dag gi dmigs gnad rnams bsgral las spyi dang 'dra'o// ling ro glang ma'i dum bu bcas ske tshe sogs dang bsres la bzhag

bsang chu sgrub pa man chad kyi ngag 'don la khyad med cing*/ yam shing dang mar khu/ khyad par gyi rdzas 'bul dus gnod byed kyi sha khrag thab kyi lha'i zhal du gsol bar bsams la me lha'i sngags dang lha sngags so so'i mthar gnod byed rgyal 'gong mā ra ya phaṭa ces btags pas dbul ba las so so'i sngags mi dgos so// thal ba lam rgya gram du mnan pa'am 'bab chu drag po'i klong du dor ro// de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas rgyud sde gong 'og kun las gsungs pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga snying por dril te bshad zin to// //gzhan yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i dpal sam+bu ṭa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las snye ma las ji skad gsungs pa ltar las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa'i las chen bcu gnyis kyi sbyin sreg sogs cho ga'i bye brag mtha' yas pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med kho na'i khyad par gyi chos/ gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i lus kyi kha thab khung du lag gnyis kyi dgang gzar blugs gzar dag gis/ bza' btung bdud rtsi'i bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa'i nang gi sbyin sreg dang*/ de bzhin du rang lus thabs ldan la brten pa'i bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i bde ba chen po'i sbyin sreg ste nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gsum dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung du/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi dgang gzar blugs gzar dag gis/ khams gsum pa'i sems sems byung gi rtog pa ma lus pa'i bsreg blug bsreg pa bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dbye tshul gzhan dang po nang dang*/ bar pa gnyis gsang ba dang*/ phyi ma de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg tu rnam par bzhag pas mtshon rgya cher gsungs kyang yi ge'i sbyor bas 'jigs pa'i phyir gzhan du shes par bya la/

'dir nyer mkho'i lag len 'ga' zhig 'chad na 'di rnams dang sbyin sreg zur pa kun sa ma dul ba'i gnas su bsgrub dgos na/ sa chog mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul ni/ gang du bya ba'i sa gzhi dri bzang pos byugs la me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ dkar gtor gnyis dang mchod pa bshams la lha gang yin pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa dang oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī e h+ye hi zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ klu dang sa bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba skad cig gis 'thon te tshom bu'i steng du bdag la zhal phyogs te bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa rnams rgyud sde 'og ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chus bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bsgrub par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ lha mos/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar sgrubs shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas sa 'og tu gshegs par bsam mo// gtor ma gnyis pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu sa bdag gnyan la sogs pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug la/

mchog sbyin gyi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis dbul/ phyogs 'dir gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ ko long dang phrag dog ma mdzad par/ zhi ba'i sems kyis bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig gats+tsha zhes brjod la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal ba ni sa bslang ba'o// tshom bu sogs bsdus la langs te sa'i dbus su lag pa gnyis bzhag cing*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ lag pas bcag cing oṃ bhūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas sa nam mkha' ltar dag par bsam pa ni sbyang ba'o// sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub par bgyi'o zhes brjod cing sems pa ni blos gzung pa ste gzung ba mdor bsdus pa'o// sbyor ba'i skabs su zhi rgyas kyi yam shing gsher cung zad yod pa lo 'bras dang bcas pa byung na legs/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi yam shing bshad tshod bzhin ma 'byor na lcang ma lta bu yung ba dang btsag sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba'ang thabs brdugs tshe mdzad srol yod la/ 'byor pa dang spros pa shin tu che bas ni/ rdzas dang mchod gtor gyi snod dang stegs pu'i khebs/ rnal 'byor pa'i gdan/ chas gos la thod dam/ prog zhu/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bcas las so so'i mdog mthun dang*/ me tog sogs mchod gtor kyang kha dog bsgyur bar mdzad/ drag po la ni gtor ma dmar po tsam las nag po mi mdzad/ dkyus 'dir thab dang rang kha sprod byas pa ni/ kye rdor man ngag lugs sogs dang mthun par stabs bde ba'i khyad par tsam yin la/ rgya bod kyi gzhung phal che bar rang dang thab gnyis ka phyogs chen du blta bar gsungs pas gang mos bya/ phyi ma'i tshe mdun du 'khod de dgang blugs sogs bstabs pa'i mos pa byed dgos gsungs/

phreng ba'i sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma dang*/ kṛ ya sa muts+tsha gnyis kar zhi ba sogs la rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi dang*/ drag po la rdo thal dang bcas pa'i so rtsi 'bul bar bshad cing*/ zur ka'i sbyin sreg 'ga' re las kyang 'byung bas las 'jam po gsum la go yu dang stod ja dkar po sbyar ba dang*/ drag po la de'i steng du rdo thal bsnan pa ste gtor ma 'bul ba mchod bstod dang bcas pa'i rjes su'am/ gshegs skyems kyi gong du dbul/ 'bul sngags oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hā zhes pa rang ming ngam/ lha sngags kyis dbul/ de dang 'brel bar oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya swā hā zhes pas na bza' las so so'i mdog can re 'bul ba'i srol yang yod cing gnyis ka me lha la'ang phul na legs/ so rtsi sbyar ma ma 'byor na go yu rkyang pa'am/ chung ja rtsi ldan gyis tshab byas kyang chog go /dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshe zhi ba'i sbyin sreg yin na dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu thab bri/ rgyas pa la dkyil 'khor gyi lho/ dbang la shar/ drag po la byang du thab bri bar bya ste/ rang nyid kha blta phyogs phyogs chen du 'grig pa dang dkyil 'khor la rgyab kyis mi phyogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ dbang bskur sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul dang*/ gtor zor sogs dang 'brel ba'i drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams la sbyor ba'i skabs su thab tu lha mtshan mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ rab gnas skabs rten lha gang bskyed kyi tshon phung dgod/ mdun bskyed kyi gdong du ting dang thod pa sogs me tog gis bkang ba bsham/ 'das pa'i me lha'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ pad+ma sogs gdan bskyed tshar ba'i rjes su/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/

rab gnas skabs rten gyi lha'i thugs ka nas zhes dang*/ gzhan la mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas zhes bsgyur/ de'i tshe mchod g.yog pas sngar gyi me tog de gus pas blangs te grogs gzhan yod na spos dang rol mos sna drangs nas thab la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba'i mthar me tog slob dpon la dbul/ slob dpon gyis thab tu cung zad dor zhing dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha rnams so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni zhes sogs kyis zhal phyag sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal btab nas/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba sogs kyi dmigs pa man chad la 'jug me tog dor tshar ba'i rjes su kha gsos la thab kyi mdun ngos su gzhag yang na thab tu dam tshig pa bskyed nas gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs byas la/ gong ltar me tog gis spyan drangs nas me tog dor ba dang mnyam du bstim/ dbang bskur ba sogs mdzad pa yod kyang snga ma gtso che/ gshegs gsol gyi tshe snga ma ltar na/ slob dpon gyis badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du mchod g.yog pas thab kyi mdun gyi me tog blangs te thab la bskor ba'i tshul gyis spos dang rol mos sna drangs te dkyil 'khor sogs la dbul/ bskyed chog byas pa yin na/ de'i rjes su dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro// 'di rnams la bdag bskyed zur du mi dgos par sbyin sreg bya ba'i mtshams der sleb pa na/ thab kyi drung 'khod de bsang chu sgrub pa sogs la 'jug pas chog cing*/ las bum yod tshe bsang chu bsham sgrub gang yang mi dgos par bum chus bya/ me lha gshegs bsdu tshar ba dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang nyid bsrungs la cho ga gang yin gyi dkyus la 'jug go /kha cig gis me tog la spos reng btsugs nas khyer ran pa na sbar zhing*/ dkyil 'khor dang thab la phyag byed pa sogs ni sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyi phyag len yin pa mi 'dra/

dus 'khor sogs la ak+ṣa ta zhes dgos pa bil 'bras me tog gis bkang ba la mdzad mod dod rung tsam yin par bzhed do// de rnams kyis las kyi dbye ba'i sreg blugs nyer mkho'i 'phros don dang bcas pa bstan zin to// //smras pa/ rgyud las gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras bu mi 'byin zhes// bden par gsungs phyir bsnyen sgrub mthar son pas// thabs mkhas zer rnon 'di yang 'chang bar 'os// thun mong rnam gzhag gser gyi phra mig 'dir// sgos chos nor bu rin thang cher bcug na// sngags spyod rgyal bu rgyal byed tshal rol par// zil gnon brjid pa'i rgyan du cis mi 'gyur// ces lha'i rnal 'byor phal mo che la sbyar rung sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khog phub rin chen gser gyi phra mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung las gsal bar ma bstan pa'i rigs thams cad la/ cho ga 'bring po 'di tsam gyis sgrub par mkhas pa gong ma'i phyag gzhes yin la/ re re nas yig cha mdzad pa 'dra yod kyang gang zag gcig gis dpe thams cad dang lung rgyun rnyed dka' ba'i phyir/ phan 'dod kyi lhag bsam pa thag tsam bskyed pa/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer ram/ thun mong du ngag dbang legs grub ces bod pas mdo smad rdzong gsar dgon du bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur ba kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang du gyur cig /shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga tāṃ/ 'di dag gi go don dang mtha' dpyod sogs rgyas par ni rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung rnam bshad bcas ji snyed pa dang*/ rang lugs rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad ye shes me phung sogs las blo gros kyi mig bsgrub par bya'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
